## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the narrow scope of this change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed
- [ ] No secrets, transcripts, local `.room`/`.claude` state, logs, or `node_modules` are included

## Architecture and risk

- Does this behavior belong in the core, an adapter, or an execution runtime?
- Does it change context sent to an external provider?
- Does it change permissions, approvals, identity, persistence, compatibility, or cost?
- If it changes a protocol or schema, what is the migration and rollback path?

## Release note

State the concise release note, or write “none.”
